AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Groceries is a household's shared grocery lists and recipe box. Each store (like Costco or Trader Joe's) has at most one open list; one more list can be open that isn't for any store, called the shopping list. Operational patterns: - Pass the store the user names as 'store' (e.g. 'Costco'); leave it empty when they don't name one. - If a function says 'Which list: ...?', ask the user that question and call it again with the store they pick. - To add several items, pass them in one call, separated by commas. - Repeat the returned sentence to the user.
AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:displayDescription: Add to and read your shared grocery lists, and open saved recipes.
